## Remote-controlled gate: three blocks

The GRAFCET of the single-button gate, implemented in three blocks: the crossing conditions `T0` to `T8`, then all the resets and all the sets of steps `X0` to `X5` (these two blocks make up the `Automatic_cycle` program), then the outputs `open` and `close` (the `Outputs` program).

### To observe

1. Closed (`limit_closed` true), a press on `remote` opens the gate: `open` becomes true.
2. While opening, a second press stops it: `open` and `close` are false.
